Static seam inspection shows store.get_manifest is called with an ArtifactRef by _read_binding, while the test compares str(artifact_id) to the bare ArtifactID string; ArtifactRef has no custom __str__. This likely prevents the mutated producer branch from firing. Treat as a test-probe/discriminator defect until a focused observation proves the mutation was applied; it is not evidence by itself that the production recheck is absent.
